messages:
anya: quick note 5 adding a tiny `safety_probe` to runtime route config so we can shadow small routing/quotas changes and assert a telemetry gate. snippet: 

anya: ```yaml
route:
  id: "billing-priority"
  safety_probe:
    enabled: true
    sample_rate: 0.01
    telemetry_gate: "routing.safety_signal_v1"
```

brian: :thumbsup: emit `probe.sampled`, `probe.fail`, `probe.p99_delta_ms`. include `X-Probe-ID` header on sampled requests for quick correlation.

devex: I'll mock a compact console card: probe status, last 1h success rate, and a "view samples" action (pre-signed urls). Keep it tiny.

anya: rollout plan: dry-run 2h @1%, canary 5% 30m -> 25% -> 100%. abort if error-rate +0.5% or p99 +50ms. gate considered passed when sampled success >=99.8% for 1h.

ops-bot: dryrun queued by anya (job dryrun-1777777777)

ops-bot: DRY-RUN (10m snapshot): sampled 130 requests, failures 0, p99 +10ms. gate: not-passed (0.0 -> needs >=99.8%).

brian: can we snapshot one sanitized sample per minute to blobstore for replay? helps RCA.

anya: yes. snapshots will include `X-Probe-ID` and a trace link. PR when ready.

devex: will post staging card link once mocked.
